reviews.title: Favorite #1 Fasting App
reviews.text: This is my second time using this app. I love all that it offers from recipe ideas, explanation of where the body is during intermittent fasting, and ability to add up calories and meal intake. Thanks FastEasy!

reviews.text: Just downloaded this app and was looking forward to start fasting, but I can’t get past the weight section when logging my info because there is no “continue” button. I’ve tried restarting the app a few times, but it has always been the same.

reviews.title: Glitches

reviews.title: Dark website!
reviews.text: Cannot get response to cancel! Don’t do this!

reviews.title: Easy and Effective
reviews.text: I use FastEasy every day. I love having the immediate feedback as to where I am in time. Additionally, I like knowing the benefits I’m receiving as I proceed along the 16 hour timeline. I don’t track hydration or food intake, but I could. The 7 minutes of exercise is easy to do and fun. My wife just got the app today and is starting. I feel supported in my Intermittent Fasting program. And, I just completed my 301st fast! Lost 14 lbs. Thank you FastEasy!

reviews.title: How do you cancel?
reviews.text:
By the sounds of it, people love your app. Well, I can’t remember where the advertisement was for “Fasteasy” that I saw, but I did sign up for it. I forgot about it, never used it and I realized at the beginning of July that you were charging $38.99/mo!  I sent an email to stop my subscription on 7/7/25 and there was a charge again on 7/21/25 for $38.99.  I resent an email at the end of July to please cancel my subscription, but never heard if you indeed canceled it. 
So, I’ve learned that it is easy to get but very difficult to cancel.  Please advise. 
Thank you.

reviews.title: Great App, needs 1 update
reviews.text: I am really enjoying this app so far. I would like to see an option for the food log where is pops up with the food and average calories as an easier way to track my daily calories. Right now I’m only tracking what I’m eating and general portion size

reviews.title: Love FastEasy
reviews.text: I love this app. It is simple to use and very helpful with daily insights. I would highly recommend FastEasy for beginners to advanced fasters. Enjoy!

reviews.title: Can’t sign back in. Not whatI was expecting.
reviews.text: I have used better fasting apps. I can’t sign in & have attempted to reset password but nothing is happening. No emails received to reset it. I never set up a password in the first place. Feel scammed & not worth the money.

reviews.title: Functionality issues
reviews.text: Nice idea but the app is not working for me. It will not allow me to add meals. When I try to add meals it only gives me a save option. Adding liquids I do get the ad option and it is counting my steps. I’ve contacted FastEasy but have not had any satisfactory response/solutions for this problem

reviews.title: Love this app!!!!
reviews.text: I’ve had challenges all my life with my weight and wanted to try something new.   I’m so glad I did.  I love FastEasy intermittent fasting.  It keeps me on track with time,  it keeps me encouraged with the information they give me I can go on and on.  You're missing out if you haven’t downloaded the app,

reviews.text: I wish this worked better for notifications. What a waste of money

reviews.title: Unsatisfied
reviews.text: I have tried to contact this company for months and no one gets back to me and I’ve tried to redo my password to login and it doesn’t work. No emails come to me no one helps no one issue. I keep getting charged and there’s no way to stop. This is an automated service and there is absolutely no actual customer service to help me, I have tried to cancel my subscription and it keeps sending me back to the beginning and I get automated responses only it would be great to actually talk to a real human being, I am very unsatisfied with not being able to login and discuss issues with an automated service

reviews.title: Terrible and deceitful
reviews.text: This app really is terrible. First, they advertise a monthly price then charge for the year with no ability to get a refund, second, the dash board and personal details are always wrong, you can’t add workouts just connect it to your pedometer to upload steps, and the training and content is just regurgitation of anything you can find online. I’m going to get my money back

reviews.title: Only 5 days in

reviews.text: I like most everything about the application, but the food diary is asking me how many calories the food is and it’s much easier if you had a system like MyFitnessPal where you just type in the food and it gives you a selection of size portions and calories. I don’t know if I’m using yours correctly, but it seems harder to use than My Fitness Pal.

reviews.title: Good but OFI
reviews.text: This is a good app, however I think there are lots of OFI’s (Opportunities for Improvement.) I’d like for the app to be easier to “edit” my fasting hours. Also I’d like to be able to estimate calories and portions in the app. Right now I have to look online elsewhere for calories and then add that information to the FastEasy app. I would love add more suggestions via email to the developer. Thanks!

reviews.title: Flexibility
reviews.text:
I’d like to have more flexibility to edit meal/beverage entries, without interrupting the current fast timer. 
I include a meal log but am not counting calories. Would be great if you had a way to enter food and automatically calculate the calories.

reviews.title: Keep your eyes out!!
reviews.text:
Its a very cool and nice app, BUT I received TWO random, UNAUTHORIZED charges in my bank account. I paid for one monthly subscription for 19.99 plus tax. That's all. That's listed on my account under Apple. Then I get a charge straight from them not under Apple for $6.99 and then another one right after for $38.99!!! I emailed them
and they were absolutely NO help. Told me I had to dispute it under my Apple account because they don't “have access” to that stuff. What? You don't have access to your own companies customers info? Uhm ok fishy. Then I read reviews on google. Apparently they are known for making unauthorized charges on peoples debit/credit cards!! I just disputed with my bank and canceled my subscription. Find another app that you don't have to worry about shady people stealing from you!!

reviews.title: Health
